worldcombat.skill.fakeout.summary: A snappy slap thrown the instant the user is sent out: top priority and near-instant, it may not hurt much but it dazes the target and cuts short whatever it was starting. Once the user has taken any other action, this opening is gone.
worldcombat.skill.fakeout.use.0: Strike first for a daze right after entering battle
worldcombat.skill.fakeout.use.1: Cut short an opening the foe is winding up
worldcombat.skill.fakeout.use.2: Nudge the foe back a step as the fight opens
worldcombat.skill.fakeout.description.0: The slap deals about %1$s contact damage; the target's defence, type and crits are applied on the hit.
worldcombat.skill.fakeout.description.1: It blinks up to %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks per tick with a %3$s block radius, and shoves the target %4$s blocks on a hit.
worldcombat.skill.fakeout.description.2: A solid hit dazes the target for %1$s; it cannot start new actions and the one it was running is interrupted.
worldcombat.skill.fakeout.feint.on: Feint form: a lighter slap that buys a longer daze and a faster wind-up.
worldcombat.skill.fakeout.feint.off: Hard form: a heavier slap with a shorter daze.
worldcombat.skill.fakeout.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s from commit. Usable only right after entering battle, before any other action.
worldcombat.skill.fakeout.growth.0: From level %1$s the slap power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.fakeout.growth.1: From level %1$s the slap power rises to %2$s and the daze to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.fakeout.preference.fei: On: a lighter slap (x0.85) that buys a longer daze (duration x1.35) and a 1-tick faster wind-up, good for opening pressure. Off: the hard form, a heavier slap (x1.12) with a shorter daze (x0.9), good for a little opening damage.
Only blink in at a foe within this distance. The blink is short, so larger values often cannot reach; smaller values keep it to point-blank openings.
